description: 招聘和人事一体的 AI 同事，把查询与执行收进一个对话。人才推荐、招聘动态、考勤绩效、审批待办，一句话问清；候选人寻访、面试分析与面试官评估，一句话发起。

display.description_en: An AI coworker for recruiting and HR that brings questions and actions into one conversation. Ask about talent recommendations, recruiting updates, attendance and performance, approvals and to-dos in one sentence; launch AI candidate sourcing, interview analysis, and interviewer evaluation just as easily.
display.description_zh: 招聘和人事一体的 AI 同事，把查询与执行收进一个对话。人才推荐、招聘动态、考勤绩效、审批待办，一句话问清；候选人寻访、面试分析与面试官评估，一句话发起。
examples_en: How much annual leave do I have left, and when does it expire?
Any attendance exceptions this month? How many times was I late?
What are the reimbursement rules for business trips?
Which candidates assigned to me are pending screening?
Find backend candidates in Hangzhou with 3+ years of Go experience
What interviews do I have today, and which still need feedback?
Summarize my team's headcount and attendance this month
What approvals are pending for me? How do I request leave?
examples_zh: 我还有多少年假？什么时候过期？
我这个月考勤有没有异常，迟到了几次？
出差报销的标准是什么？
我名下有哪些待筛选的候选人？
帮我找 3 年以上 Go 经验、在杭州的后端候选人
我今天有哪些面试？哪些还没写反馈？
统计我管理团队的人数和本月出勤情况
我有哪些待办审批？请假流程怎么发起？
display.name: Moka HR 智能体
